definitions.explanation: A fast-food chain serving {牛丼|ぎゅうどん} (beef bowl), founded in Tokyo in 1899 and known for being cheap, quick and tasty.

examples.japanese: {昼|ひる}ごはん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{吉野家|よしのや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{吉野家|よしのや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}→牛丼：08600_gyuudon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: Yoshinoya's beef bowls are cheap and fast.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧{帰|がえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{吉野家|よしのや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}→牛丼：08600_gyuudon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧さっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: On busy days I grab a quick beef bowl at Yoshinoya on the way home from work.

notes:
The chain's slogan is ⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧、やすい、はやい (tasty, cheap, fast).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {吉野家|よしのや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}→牛丼：08600_gyuudon⟧: Yoshinoya beef bowl
- つゆだく: with extra sauce (a popular way to order)
- ⟦{大盛|おおも}り→大盛り：08162_oomori⟧: a large serving

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Its rivals are すき{家|や} and {松屋|まつや}; the three are often compared.
